title: Har dil ki sada
body:
kehte hai ahle aza har dil ki hai ye sada
ya hussain ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
kehta hai khud ye khuda zehra ki jaan marhaba
ya hussain ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
tu ne bichaya musalla wahan
dam tod de khud ibadat jahan
is hausle par tere qurban salle alaa
ya hussain ya hussain
kehte hai ahle aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
aadam ke dam ke muhafiz ho tum
musa ki haibat mein naafiz ho tum
isaa ka tum maujiza tum khizr ke rehnuma
ya hussain ya hussain
kehte hai ahle aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
raushan tere noor se noore hai
ghairat zada jalwa e toor hai
khoon se tere hogayi matti bhi khaake shifa
ya hussain ya hussain
kehte hai ahle aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye hausla to kisi mein nahi
quwaat kisi ye nabi mein nahi
tu ne uthaaye magar baazu e shaah e wafa
ya hussain ya hussain
kehte hai ahle aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ne sitam kis tarha se saha
tum ne ye gham kis tarha se saha
laasha jawan laal ka kaandhon pe kaise rakha
ya hussain ya hussain
kehte hai ahle aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
is gham mein kaampe zameen aasman
is gham mein tadpe ye kaun o makaan
asghar ka tu ne lahoo chehre pe kaise mala
ya hussain ya hussain
kehte hai ahle aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
ran mein musibat ye tum par padi
tum par qayamat ki thi ye ghadi
khanjar talay haath jab maa ne teri rakh diya
ya hussain ya hussain
kehte hai ahle aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
aisi kisi ki bhi mayyat nahi
yasir kisi ki ye ghurbat nahi
tareekh mein ek hai teeron pe laasha tera
ya hussain ya hussain
kehte hai ahle aza...
author: Yasir Abbas
